reviews.title: Improved CPU Temperature and Noise level in AM4 Motherboard
reviews.comment: Great AM4 cooler, improve the AIO CPU Cooler and reduce greatly the noise generated. The instructions are not ilustrated for AM4 Motherboard, but are clear to follow. The size was not a problem for my case and my RAM neither SSD had problems with it.

reviews.comment: Have this cooler in a 3u sever case and it works perfectly, cools an i5 12400 with no issues

reviews.title: Good cooling fan for processor.
reviews.comment: Good product, easy install for a technician, not too complicated for a novis. Does a good job cooling. Quiet. Lower profile than some. I added a second fan with the provided fan clips. Instructions were easy to follow. Well packaged, came with all necessary parts and packages were well labeled.
reviews.author: Retired Old Guy
